_comment: Every substantive data layer points here by source_id. licence_status is one of: verified | conditional | unresolved | internal | provisional. in_use=false entries are registered for traceability only: nothing in the dataset is derived from them. No entry claims commercial clearance, because research has not established it for any source.

sources.name: Tanzil Quran text (Uthmani)
sources.version: 1.1 (release of 12 Feb 2021; file header reads 'Uthmani, Version 1.1', copyright 2007-2026)
sources.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (Tanzil Project). Terms read on https://tanzil.net/docs/Text_License : verbatim copies only, changing the text is not allowed; the source (Tanzil Project) must be clearly indicated with a link to tanzil.net; the copyright block must be kept in verbatim copies and reproduced in derived files.
sources.allowed_use: Display and search of the Qur'anic text unmodified, with attribution + link (shown in the app footer and Source panel); the copyright block is retained in data/raw/tanzil/quran-uthmani.txt. Normalised forms are stored separately and never displayed.
sources.notes: Downloaded from tanzil.net/pub/download/index.php on 2026-10-06 with parameters quranType=uthmani, outType=txt-2, and every optional symbol switched off (no pause marks, no sajdah signs, no rub-el-hizb signs, no tatweel), after the terms checkbox was ticked on QURRA's behalf with the owner's approval. File SHA-256: bf4f57b968d03f4131c070b1e285da9be0e0a108a21c910e872801ca273312c8 (6,236 ayah lines). The official file prefixes the basmala onto ayah 1 of every surah except 1 and 9 (two spellings: 110 lines use 'بِسْمِ', and 95:1 and 97:1 use 'بِّسْمِ' with an extra shadda in the official file); the raw file keeps it verbatim and data/qurra/ayahs.json separates it as source_prefix. 'Verified' here means the text and its licence terms come from the official source and the Stage 2 pilot was diffed against it (see STAGE_3_REPORT.md); it does not assert any wider commercial clearance beyond the CC BY 3.0 terms. Pause marks are omitted by choice (a Tanzil-supported option) to keep word tokens clean; they can be re-added from a new official download.

sources.name: QURRA editorial metadata
sources.notes: General QURRA editorial metadata. Since Stage 3 the surah and juz metadata come from TANZIL_METADATA, not from here.

sources.name: QURRA Stage 1 demo segmentation and morphology
sources.allowed_use: Prototype display only, with a provisional label.
sources.notes: Hand-authored for the Stage 1 demo for 9 ayahs. NOT imported from QAC, MASAQ, QuranMorph or any corpus. Not reviewed by a qualified Arabic-grammar scholar. Segment spellings were adapted to the Uthmani text during the Stage 2 migration.

sources.name: QURRA vocabulary glosses
sources.allowed_use: Lexical glosses, learner notes and root core-field descriptions authored by QURRA.
sources.notes: Short vocabulary glosses, not Qur'an translation. Drafts, unreviewed. No third-party dictionary text is copied.

sources.name: QURRA demo ayah renderings
sources.notes: Working renderings written for the prototype, not quoted from any published translation and not reviewed. They are not an authoritative translation.

sources.name: QURRA demo conjugation triplets
sources.allowed_use: Prototype display only, with a provisional label.
sources.notes: Perfective / imperfective / imperative citation forms entered by hand. Not reviewed.

sources.name: QURRA Stage 1 demo root placeholders
sources.allowed_use: Prototype display only, with a provisional label.
sources.notes: Root letters entered by hand in the Stage 1 demo. They were NOT assigned under the QURRA Root Verification Protocol, carry no evidence, and are not derived from QAC or Wikidata. They must be re-assigned under the frozen protocol before being shown as authoritative.

sources.name: QURRA Root Verification Protocol
sources.allowed_use: Governs how verified roots will be assigned.
sources.notes: PENDING EXPERT REVIEW. Not frozen. The expert sign-off checklist is in docs/expert-review/ and has not been sent to anyone. No root in the dataset has been assigned under this protocol.

sources.name: MASAQ Qur'anic morphology dataset
sources.licence: Conflicting labels (CC BY 4.0 vs CC BY-NC 3.0) on identical files.
sources.allowed_use: None until the licence is clarified.
sources.notes: Registered for traceability. Nothing in this dataset is derived from it.

sources.name: QuranMorph / Qabas lemma layer
sources.licence: Gated access; upstream lexicon terms unresolved.
sources.notes: Registered for traceability. Nothing in this dataset is derived from it.

sources.name: Quranic Arabic Corpus
sources.licence: GPL with a no-modification clause; the site FAQ states non-commercial use.
sources.allowed_use: None. Not used as data, fallback or evidence.
sources.notes: Registered so that its absence is explicit.

sources.name: Wikidata Arabic lexemes
sources.licence: CC0 platform; root statements have weak provenance.
sources.allowed_use: None as production data. Comparison and QA only, after a decision is logged.
sources.notes: Registered so that its absence is explicit.

sources.name: Tanzil Quran Metadata
sources.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (stated in the file header).
sources.allowed_use: Surah names, ayah counts, revelation place and order, juz start positions; attribution to Tanzil shown with the text.
sources.notes: data/raw/tanzil/quran-data.js downloaded unmodified from https://tanzil.net/res/text/metadata/quran-data.js on 2026-10-06 (SHA-256 9e9930c592aaa34b5c7a79ff4e99ffdc782263a266090bfe2c49e4ed4bac4ca4). Surah transliterations (name_en) are Tanzil's own, e.g. 'Al-Faatiha'.
